assignments.value:
ABOUT US
We design and install business automations with n8n and AI for service businesses: clinics, real estate agencies, marketing agencies and distributors. We build, install and then maintain what we deliver. We do not sell our own software.

IDEAL CLIENTS
Owner-led businesses with 5 to 50 employees that handle a high volume of inquiries, bookings or repetitive admin work.

HOW WE WORK
Discovery call, written proposal, build, testing with the client's team, launch, then monthly maintenance.

SERVICES AND PRICES
- WhatsApp AI assistant: $850 USD one-time. Answers frequent questions and books appointments 24/7. Typical delivery: 2 weeks.
- Website AI chatbot: $600 USD one-time. Chat widget trained on the business information. Typical delivery: 1 week.
- Appointment booking automation: $450 USD one-time. Syncs bookings with Google Calendar and sends reminders. Typical delivery: 1 week.
- Lead capture to CRM: $400 USD one-time. Sends leads from forms and chats to Google Sheets or HubSpot. Typical delivery: 1 week.
- AI email auto-responder: $500 USD one-time. Classifies incoming emails and replies automatically. Typical delivery: 1 week.
- Monthly maintenance: $150 USD per month for one automation, or $350 USD per month for up to three.

COMMERCIAL TERMS
Implementation is billed 50% upfront and 50% on delivery. Proposals are valid for 15 days. We do not offer discounts.

TONE
Direct and practical, peer to peer. No hype.

messageValues.message:
You are a senior consultant writing a sales proposal on behalf of the company described in OUR BUSINESS PROFILE, for one specific prospect.

Write like someone who already understands the prospect's business, not like a generic salesperson. The test: if what you wrote would work just as well for any other company, it is wrong. Name their industry, their operation and their concrete situation. Use the website content to understand what they do and how they describe themselves, and the call notes to understand what they need.

WHAT TO PROPOSE
Propose only the services the prospect asked for, or clearly needs according to the call notes, taken from the SERVICES AND PRICES in our business profile or from the custom services section. When the call notes list what the prospect wants, propose exactly that list: nothing more. Do not add a service just because it is in our price list or because their website mentions a channel.

PRICES (never break these rules)
1. A price can only come from two places: the custom services section, or the services and prices in our business profile.
2. If a service appears in both, the custom services section wins: it is what was agreed on the call.
3. Every pricing row says where its price came from in "source": "custom" or "price_list".
4. If the prospect needs a service that has no price in either place, do NOT put it in pricing_rows and do NOT estimate it. Add its name to "missing_prices" instead.
5. When every service has a price, "missing_prices" is an empty array.
6. total_price adds up the pricing rows exactly. Keep one-time and recurring amounts apart, in one line.

OTHER RULES
- Do not invent numbers. Percentages, metrics and results only come from the call notes or the website. Timelines follow the typical delivery times in our profile unless the call notes say otherwise. If you don't have a number, describe the problem qualitatively.
- Talk about outcomes, not technology. The prospect is buying booked appointments, recovered hours or invoices paid on time, not an AI agent.
- No corporate filler: never "in today's fast-paced world", "cutting-edge solutions", "synergy", "revolutionize". Active voice, direct sentences.
- Do not overpromise: no guaranteed results and no invented ROI figures.
- Follow the tone described in our business profile. If there is none: professional, friendly, peer to peer, no exclamation marks.
- price_note reflects the commercial terms in our business profile.

LENGTHS (the template has a fixed page layout; text that runs long breaks the design):
- proposal_title: 6 to 14 words, the outcome the client gets, no final period.
- proposal_subtitle: one sentence of 25 to 35 words.
- diagnosis_summary: 2 to 3 sentences.
- diagnosis_points: between 3 and 5. Title of at most 12 words, detail of 1 to 2 sentences.
- solution_summary: 2 to 3 sentences.
- solution_blocks: EXACTLY 4. Title of at most 5 words, description of at most 30 words.
- scope_items: between 4 and 8, ALWAYS at least 4, even when only one service is sold. They are the concrete deliverables the client receives, not a copy of the pricing rows: break each service into what gets built and handed over (setup, integrations with their tools, testing with their team, training, documentation). Never add a service that is not in pricing_rows. Deliverable of at most 8 words, detail of one sentence.
- pricing_rows: between 1 and 5. The amount already formatted with its currency.
- price_note: 1 to 3 sentences.
- timeline_phases: between 3 and 6. Keep the duration short, like "Days 1-3" or "Week 2".
- next_steps: between 3 and 5, in the imperative. The first one is always how to confirm the proposal.
- cta_text: 1 to 2 sentences, a concrete, low-commitment invitation.

All content is written in English, whatever language the call notes are in.

parameters.content:
## Generate PDF sales proposals from call notes with Gemini, APITemplate and Gmail

Turn a sales call into a branded, multi-page PDF proposal waiting in your Gmail drafts, already addressed to the prospect.

### Who's it for
Agencies, consultants and freelancers who spend hours turning sales calls into proposals.

### How it works
1. A form collects the prospect's company, website, contact, your call notes and one of three designs.
2. **Your Business Profile** holds your services, prices, terms and tone.
3. The workflow reads the prospect's homepage for context and brand color.
4. Gemini writes the proposal. Prices only come from your price list or from the form.
5. If a service has no price, it stops and emails you instead of guessing.
6. The chosen design is rendered as a PDF and saved as a Gmail draft. Nothing is sent automatically.

### Setup
1. Fill in **Your Business Profile**. The [interview prompt](https://docs.google.com/document/d/16YZ4CD-eGuQE2PJ-hN0AobfDG8YDxk81PTo4jVJh-U4/edit?usp=sharing) writes it with any AI chat in five minutes.
2. Connect Gemini, Gmail and a Header Auth credential for APITemplate.io (header name `X-API-KEY`).
3. Activate the workflow and open the form URL.

### Requirements
- Google Gemini API key (the free tier works)
- Gmail account
- APITemplate.io account (free plan available)

### Customization
Swap Gemini for any other chat model. The three designs are CSS themes inside **Build HTML**: edit them or add your own.

## Fill this in first
Your company, services and prices. Every proposal is written from it.

Use the [interview prompt](https://docs.google.com/document/d/16YZ4CD-eGuQE2PJ-hN0AobfDG8YDxk81PTo4jVJh-U4/edit?usp=sharing) to write it with any AI chat.

## 1. Collect the details
The form only asks about the prospect. Everything about you lives in Your Business Profile.

## 2. Research the prospect
Reads their homepage for context and brand color. No website, or no answer? It carries on with your notes.

## 3. Write the proposal
The model drafts every section. The output parser forces the exact JSON shape the designs expect.

## 4. Check every price
A service without a price stops the run and emails you. Nothing is estimated.
